## Where I am
Dashboards v2 keyboard move/resize and the focus ring are implemented on `tom/dashboard-keyboard` (commit `8f1a2c7`) in PR #423, which is open with Priya requested as reviewer. PR #418, the grid itself, is merged, and Priya's two follow-up comments are what #423 addresses. `dashboards_v2` is on for zest-grocers on staging only; production is untouched. (source: ses-db-4, d4-05, src-pr418)

- [en-cours] PR #423 (keyboard move/resize, focus ring) is open, waiting for Priya's review. (source: d4-05)
- [prochaine-étape] Priya rehearses the Zest demo on staging. (source: d4-06)
- [prochaine-étape] Tom flips the production `dashboards_v2` flag himself on the morning of the 24th, the day of the Zest demo. (source: d4-06, b2-04)
- [essai-raté] dnd-kit's KeyboardSensor on top of react-grid-layout applied every move twice and broke mouse drag, so it was removed. (source: d4-02)
- [essai-raté] CSS container queries do nothing on Zest's iPads (iOS 15, Safari < 16). (source: b2-01)
- [décision] Keyboard handling is our own `useGridKeyboard()` on the layout state, with no dnd-kit. (source: d4-04)
- [décision] ResizeObserver replaces container queries, so there is only one sizing system. (source: b2-02)
- [décision] Keep recharts; the visx migration (#401) is closed. (source: c3-03)
- [décision] Legacy v1 dashboards stay available behind the flag until January; nothing is removed now. (source: b2-04)
